goals: I want to complete my income tax filing by next week

phases.title: Preparation & Document Collection
phases.description: Collect all necessary tax documents and verify personal information before entering data into tax software.

tasks.title: Gather all W-2 forms from employers
tasks.description: Collect W-2s from each employer and verify accuracy of employer name, EIN, and amounts.

tasks.title: Gather 1099 forms (interest, dividends, etc.)
tasks.description: Collect all 1099-INT, 1099-DIV, 1099-MISC, and 1099-NEC forms and verify amounts.

tasks.title: Gather receipts for deductible expenses (charity, medical, etc.)
tasks.description: Collect receipts and statements for all deductible expenses and categorize them.

tasks.title: Gather records of any capital gains/losses
tasks.description: Collect brokerage statements and transaction records for capital gains/losses.

tasks.title: Gather bank statements for interest income
tasks.description: Collect bank statements showing interest earned for the tax year.

tasks.title: Gather records of any foreign income or assets
tasks.description: Collect documentation of foreign income, foreign bank accounts, and foreign assets.

tasks.title: Verify personal information (SSN, address)
tasks.description: Confirm SSN, filing status, and address are correct on all documents.

phases.title: Data Entry & Calculation
phases.description: Enter all collected data into tax software and perform preliminary calculations.

tasks.title: Input W-2 data into tax software
tasks.description: Enter employer information and wages from each W-2 into the software.

tasks.title: Input 1099 data into tax software
tasks.description: Enter interest, dividend, and other 1099 information into the software.

tasks.title: Enter deductible expenses into tax software
tasks.description: Input all deductible expenses, ensuring correct categories and amounts.

tasks.title: Enter capital gains/losses into tax software
tasks.description: Input sale details, cost basis, and proceeds for capital assets.

tasks.title: Verify tax credits (e.g., education, child tax credit)
tasks.description: Check eligibility and input applicable tax credits into the software.

tasks.title: Review preliminary tax liability calculation
tasks.description: Examine the software’s preliminary calculation for accuracy and completeness.

phases.title: Review & Submission
phases.description: Perform a final audit of the return, resolve discrepancies, and file electronically.

tasks.title: Cross-check all entries against source documents
tasks.description: Verify each line item in the software matches the original documents.

tasks.title: Resolve any discrepancies or missing information
tasks.description: Correct errors and gather any missing documents before finalizing.

tasks.title: File tax return electronically
tasks.description: Submit the completed tax return via the IRS e-file system and confirm receipt.
